narrative.overview: A boarding pass for preparing a movie and a departures board with a remote for watching it, on one near-black platform with one signal yellow.
keyCharacteristics: One dark platform, one paper-stock surface, one signal yellow.
Condensed Archivo for choices, JetBrains Mono for system readouts.
Square marks, dotted perforation, hairline rules; no shadows.
Tonal layering is the whole depth system.
Every tap target is at least 44px.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only hue: a fill on a committing action or a marker on a pending or unconfirmed state.

rules.name: The Ink Is The Selection Rule
rules.body: A chosen option is white ink, a filled square mark and a larger name, never a color.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo speaks for the person, mono for the machine.

rules.name: The Thumb Floor Rule
rules.body: Every control is 44px or larger in both axes.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Cards separate by lightness alone, not shadow.

dos: Do spend Signal Yellow (#ffcc00) on a committing action or a pending state, and nothing else.
Do set times, hosts and counts in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do keep one problem block and one Detener visible.
donts: Don't add a second hue or a gradient fill.
Don't use drop shadows to lift a card.
